component.name: Thorium Browser
component.summary: High-performance AVX2/ARM64 Chromium browser with NVIDIA/Mesa hardware acceleration

description.p: Thorium is an optimized fork of Chromium featuring compiler-level optimizations (AVX2/NEON), custom patches, and enhanced multimedia decoding capabilities. This package is pre-configured for seamless NVIDIA VA-API integration while preserving native hardware acceleration across AMD, Intel, and industrial GPUs.
